messages:
Jordan (People Ops): Quick help needed — Lina took a taxi from CDG to hotel during a strike, company card charged €235 but we don't have an itemized receipt. We have the taxi company's PDF confirmation and the EUR charge on the card statement. Can we file this?
Lina (Eng): Yep that's mine. I forgot to get the paper receipt, but I have the confirmation email and the card transaction showing EUR 235. Also tip included.
Max (Finance): That's OK. For foreign-currency charges we prefer the card statement showing the final posted amount. Use the card's posted USD amount if available; if not, include the EUR statement plus the bank's conversion screenshot or the posted exchange rate.
Lina (Eng): The card statement only shows EUR. I can pull the online bank view that shows the USD conversion for the charge.
Max (Finance): Perfect — attach both. Note in the expense description: original currency, original amount, and converted amount.
Jordan (People Ops): What's the manager approval threshold for taxi/fares? This one seems high.
Omar (Manager): I approve given the strike and delay — please include this note in the report: "Approved: OMAR - airport strike caused 2hr delay, unavoidable taxi surcharge."
Max (Finance): Also flag: for any single ground-transport >$150 we need a manager sign-off, and we check reasonableness. VAT recovery: taxis in many countries don't have recoverable VAT — do not request VAT reclaim for taxis unless you have a proper VAT invoice.
Lina (Eng): Understood. Will not seek VAT. Do we reimburse in EUR or USD?
Max (Finance): We'll reimburse in the employee's payroll currency (USD). We use the bank's posted conversion rate for the transaction date. If you used a manual conversion, include the provider and rate.
Jordan (People Ops): For missing itemized receipts: for amounts over $75 we require a manager note + the operator confirmation. For under $75 we can accept an affidavit + card statement.
Lina (Eng): I've uploaded: taxi PDF confirmation, card statement line showing EUR 235, screenshot of bank conversion showing USD 255. Omar's approval screenshot attached.
expense-bot: Expense report EXP-2026-299 created by Lina. Status: pending finance review.
Max (Finance): I'll review the attachments and then approve if the conversion matches posted rate.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks — I'll add this scenario to the travel FAQ ("airport disruption: high taxi fare procedure").
